episodes.title: Why I Am a Protestant   Yet I Will Rejoice
episodes.description:
Catholic, Orthodox, or Protestant: what separates the three branches of Christianity, and why does it matter? In this episode, Brandon Anderson explains why he is unashamedly a Protestant. Starting with Martin Luther and the Reformation, he walks through the five solas: Scripture alone, grace alone, faith alone, Christ alone, and to the glory of God alone. Along the way he looks at why Scripture is the final authority over tradition and the Pope (2 Timothy 3–4), why no indulgence, pilgrimage, or work can earn salvation (Ephesians 2), how the thief on the cross was saved by faith without ever being baptized (Luke 23), and why Jesus' sacrifice on the cross was sufficient once for all. Brandon also shares why he believes there are true followers of Jesus in all three branches, and why these five truths still shape his life today.

⏱️ CHAPTERS:
0:00 Intro
0:20 The three branches of Christendom
1:30 Martin Luther and the Reformation
4:12 The five solas
5:16 Scripture alone
7:29 Grace alone
9:33 Faith alone
15:44 Christ alone
20:24 To the glory of God alone
23:46 Conclusion
25:49 Thank you for watching

episodes.title: Should Christians Trust AI With Their Questions?
episodes.description:
More people, especially teenagers, now take their hardest questions to AI before they ever ask a pastor. In this Ask Away! Live Q&A, Brandon Anderson and Joshua Garner talk about why that matters. AI can gather information and arrange it into knowledge, but wisdom begins with the fear of the Lord, and a machine can't fear God. We talk about AI's counterfeit humility, why it tends to tell us what we want to hear (2 Timothy 4), how the Holy Spirit gifts believers to serve one another (1 Peter 4), and why pastors can bear fruit in a way AI never can (Matthew 7). AI is a useful tool, and Christians have no reason to fear it, because Jesus is Lord over all of it.

⏱️ CHAPTERS:
0:00 Intro
0:24 Why ask a pastor instead of AI?
1:28 Every believer is gifted by the Holy Spirit
6:12 Why people don't trust pastors with hard questions
7:39 AI's counterfeit humility
8:40 Perceived wisdom and the fear of the Lord
10:46 Information vs. knowledge vs. wisdom
13:49 Why ask a pastor who might fail you?
15:40 Pastors bear fruit; AI is fruitless
18:14 Podcasts, accountability, and integrity
20:32 Itching ears: AI as an echo chamber
23:05 "It completes me": a conversation in the sauna
26:05 AI as a discipleship issue
27:06 Use the tool, and don't be afraid
30:04 Thanks for watching

📖 SCRIPTURE IN THIS EPISODE:
Romans 8:9–11 • Acts 2 • Galatians 5:22–23 • 1 Corinthians 12 • 1 Peter 4:7–11 • 1 Timothy 3 • Proverbs 1:7 • Matthew 7:15–20 • 2 Timothy 4:1–5 • Proverbs 25:16 • Hebrews 12:5–11 • Philippians 2:10–11
